candidate.description: BIPX Aldric/Lyra, textured enemy LODs, Walker attack phases, swept player rifle, keyboard aim/upgrades and reconnect; frozen19:08candidate before authority/enemy-sweep/entry fixes.

environment.note: Isolated headless Chrome; preflight confirmed ANGLE Metal Apple M5 Pro WebGL2. User Chrome remains open by request; no other QA GPU sessions. Compact viewports are emulation, not physical mobile.

candidate.note: Stable recorded candidate. Changes after the suite create a new candidate and do not inherit this pass.

observations: 874 x 402 landscape gameplay now shows the full LVL 1 text under the sword skill icon, unlike the 18:06 baseline. Main health/score, pause/sound and both touch controls are visible. Camera covers a larger arena region; whether small targets remain readable on physical mobile is pending.

390 x 844 character selection displays both model portraits, role/weapon labels, selection text, name field and both mode buttons legibly. Full-page desktop capture does not establish physical mobile keyboard behavior.

The actual simultaneous touch movement/firing portrait capture shows Lyra, muzzle glow and narrow white tracer; the remote Walker silhouette is small and soft. Canvas detail remains visibly softer than DOM text. Cyan portal and dark tree canopies remain strong visual elements.

Aldric natural 60 s capture shows imported Walkers surrounding the player, kill/pickup rewards, aim/lock rings and visible sword action. The top HUD duplicates Solo as Solo Solo; a floating Lâmina encantada +40% damage label appears truncated/small in the native capture.

The synthetic bounded-horde capture replaces the previous tan/green/purple cylindrical far proxies with textured character silhouettes matching Walker/Brute/Lich/Orc shapes. Dense rows contain repeated static poses, and tree canopy dither still obscures or visually complicates groups near the player. This fixture grants a legacy loadout/level 16 and seeds stationary formations; those HUD icons are not natural warrior abilities.
Natural Walker pursuit/attack and imported Aldric/Lyra are observed. Staged Lich/Brute reanimations are absent from this candidate; their distinct caster/heavy acting remains unfinished.

Actual class combat integration and the separate 21-family catalogue passed shader/runtime/GL/pause/quality/resource checks. Catalogue/placed targets are synthetic and do not establish natural triggers for every family.

Natural input observes rifle muzzle/tracer and sword/impact/target/pickup feedback. Dense fixture is stationary and cannot establish readability throughout dense live combat. Exact physical fist/forged-weapon state machines and animated hunting-clone ability from upstream remain documented exclusions.

Two real-input natural runs lasted 100 s each with no injected world/health/XP/score. Aldric observed 21 kills in one life, level 3,5 upgrades,4 natural deaths/restarts. Lyra 55 kills, wave 2,level 5,8 upgrades,1 natural death/restart. Target-aware automation is not a human feel review.

Integrated rifle sweep 9 cases passes actual 35 ms crossing/nearest impact/near miss/lifetime/piercing without production test hooks. Zombie/runner melee 15 solo and 13 server cases pass windup at 0.46 s, exact-once impact, range/arc dodge, freeze/death cancellation, pause and late-attach phase.

Known enemy projectile endpoint-only grazing collision still misses contact in source-matched extracted-server CPU proof. Natural runs show long main-thread stalls; comprehensive difficulty/boss/feel review pending.

Desktop/390 x 844/874 x 402 menus, help/settings/ranking/selection/start/HUD/touch pass. Full landscape skill level label is now visible. Keyboard Tab/Enter, WASD/IJKL/Space, diagonal release, partial hold, pointer takeover, chained upgrades, focus restoration and announcements pass both classes.

Observed minor polish gaps: duplicate Solo text and small/truncated floating drop label. Root code audit proves local multiplayer button still redirects to fixed production URL; this loses local candidate/selection context and is a functional defect. Direct-URL multiplayer tests do not cover that button.

Desktop Chrome emulation includes actual simultaneous touch movement/firing, portrait/landscape menus, controls and releases. Playwright WebKit passes 3 desktop/compact scenarios with rendered models, keyboard combat, native touch activation, audio unlock, pause and settings.

These are host-engine/viewport checks, not Safari.app, physical iOS/Android GPU, safe-area keyboard or sustained thermal evidence. Canvas is visibly softer than DOM text; physical target readability remains unreviewed.

13 processed ElevenLabs cues decoded. Actual compressor-output PCM captured 15.872 s with peak-7.614662 dBFS; no clipping observed. Real rifle input, synthetic cue audition, pause/mute/persistence, distance/pan/voice bounds pass.
Captured waveform and automation do not prove subjective mix, event recognition, fatigue or hardware speaker/headphone performance. Listening remains pending.

Current isolated headless Chrome 153 on Apple M 5 Pro reports ANGLE Metal/WebGL 2 and about 60 Hz; user Chrome remains open by request. Natural 100 s rates 59.8224/59.7024 FPS, p 9516.8 ms;6 frames>50 ms total, worst 183.3 ms in both runs. All six overlap longtasks and none overlaps recorded screenshots. Diagnostic trace pending for causality.

Four~12 s stationary seeded stress samples 94/362 enemies average 59.8–60 FPS, p 9516.7–16.8 ms. Wave 16 desktop has one 66.7 ms frame. Frozen stress is not active dense combat. No invisible threats in measured integrity reports. Physical mobile and longer sustained sessions remain pending.

98.665 ms main-thread task in animate/render;95 ms sampled in renderer,83.526 ms inclusive in WebGLProgram onFirstUse/getUniforms, repeated synchronous GLES 2 GetProgramiv waits. No overlapping screenshot or GC event in this task; other historical spikes not individually attributed.

Two actual browser clients share server world and rewards; fresh late join, class-only authority, dead no-attack, real IPC-triggered authoritative wipe pass. Reconnect protocol verifies private identity/run/HP/score/XP preservation,30 s real grace, stale-state rejection, terminal death, explicit idempotent startRun, no ledger duplication from reconnect and socket takeover.

Actual browser socket-wrapper fault injection proves input/simulation freezes during disconnect, lost reward recovery, ACK replay without duplicate XP and runStarted replay. Resume credentials are excluded from reports.

Supplemental isolated protocol audit proves XP 0 clients may forge level 999/build, HP 600 and maximum attack multipliers. Solo HTTP submission accepts fake and repeated totals. These open failures prevent a complete authority/security claim despite reconnect success. Local multiplayer button still opens remote production.

Keyboard-only navigation/aim/fire/settings, focus restoration, chained upgrade navigation and live announcement pass. Reduced motion, labels and browser zoom allowance are present; compact viewport menus have no horizontal overflow.
Full contrast audit, screen-reader gameplay, remapping, color-only cue equivalence, low-vision target readability and physical device zoom/keyboard are unverified.

All 29 suites passed for identical 114 runtime/asset/package files and unchanged verifier files. Browser telemetry has zero page/console/network/HTTP errors; expected test-only audio-tap deprecation warning is retained.20 UI character switches hold 67 geometries/27 textures;3 death/restarts 68/28.

Earlier unexpected natural Lyra pause remains open/not-reproduced; neither current 100 s run reproduced it. Main-thread stalls, authority exploits, entry-navigation error and enemy projectile grazing miss remain open.100 s runs and bounded lifecycle checks are not a long-session soak.

Enemy projectile endpoint-only test misses a grazing crossing: source-matched extracted CPU function reproduces no damage.
Local multiplayer button hardcodes remote production URL, leaving local candidate and selected-character storage.

Six full-suite natural frames exceed 50 ms. Follow-up tracing reproduces 100 ms frame dominated by synchronous shader-program first-use/uniform initialization during gameplay; other recorded spikes remain unattributed.
Historical unexpected natural pause remains open/not-reproduced.
Mobile canvas sharpness, tree occlusion/static distant poses, duplicate Solo and small/truncated floating pickup label require further polish.
missingEvidence: Physical iOS/Android play, simultaneous inputs, safe areas/keyboard, GPU/thermal performance.
Human perceptual audio listening and combat-feel review.
Every applicable VFX natural trigger and temporal dense-live-combat readability.
Distinct caster/heavy monster choreography; staged Lich/Brute not installed.
Exhaustive screen-reader/contrast/zoom/remapping and redundant gameplay cue review.
Long-session soak and broader adverse-network cases beyond selected dropped messages/reconnect.
scope: Paths/hashes identify artifacts. TypeSafe Jev is text-only and cannot inspect referenced media. Explicit natural input is distinct from seeded/IPC/catalogue fixtures. Automated suite pass is not a score and does not clear supplemental failures.
